subject: Trading
title: The Edge of Discipline
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Edge of Discipline.

hook.text: Two traders use the same strategy. One follows the rules. One doesn't. After a year, their results are worlds apart.

buildup.text: A trading edge is a statistical advantage. But the edge only works if applied consistently, trade after trade.

discovery.text: Discipline is what converts a theoretical edge into real profits. Without it, random execution destroys the math.

twist.text: Most traders have access to winning strategies. Few have the discipline to execute them through discomfort and loss.

climax.text: Risk management IS the edge for most traders. The strategy matters less than the consistency of execution.

punchline.text: Discipline is the rarest and most valuable edge.

quiz.question: Why is discipline considered a trading edge?
options: It replaces the need for strategy
It turns theoretical advantages into real profits through consistent execution
